caption: The video captures a brightly lit mirrored dance studio with sheer and grey curtains, a glossy floor, and ceiling panels. Two women seen from behind wear matching cyan tops and magenta skirts, while their front-facing reflections move with them. The left dancer in silver heels shifts weight and steps as her right arm rises into an open-palm wave. The right dancer in gold heels extends an arm outward, lowers both arms, and later lifts one again. Their skirts flare and settle subtly with each hip movement and weight change. In the visible portion, the left dancer's arm lowers toward the hips, then rises again near her head. The right dancer's back foot lifts, plants, and lifts again while her head and torso turn off to the side. The fixed camera keeps the mirror seam and background stable, so the motion remains the dancers' continuing steps and arm patterns.
